title: He's Out. Or Is He?
subject: Jensen Huang
role: Founder, resigned as Nvidia CEO on Nov 12, 2026
parody: Parody game. The situation is real and linked below; every statement, headline and reaction in the game is invented. Not affiliated with or endorsed by anyone depicted.

setup.headline: He's out. Or is he?
setup.dek: Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation on Thursday, days after opening an investigation into reports he was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. Two big investors now want him back. Five questions. You get the first words of each answer; finish them.

endings.headline: THE COMEBACK.
endings.dek: The board takes him back. The jacket returns to the keynote.

endings.headline: BACK BY CHRISTMAS?
endings.dek: Investors are sold. The board wants one more week.

endings.headline: FOUNDER EMERITUS.
endings.dek: A nice title, a nice office, no keys.

endings.headline: STILL OUT.
endings.dek: The board thanks him for his contributions. Again.

endings.headline: SUBPOENAED.
endings.dek: Legal has asked everyone to stop typing.

context: Real situation, mid-November 2026: Nov 8 the Nvidia board opened an independent investigation into reports Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort (a contact linked to Megaspeed, a Singapore firm that bought billions in Nvidia gear and is probed over export controls). The FBI is looking into it. Nov 12 he resigned as CEO and director; CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO and Harvey Jones the first board chair. Nvidia lost over $600B in market value that week. Nov 14 two major investors urged the board to consider his return. House committee chairs want him at a closed-door briefing on Nov 18; his trip to APEC in Shenzhen is in doubt. Keep everything non-sexual.
